Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

In this session, we learn methods of computational chemistry.

Key details

  • There are two main methods depending on starting point theory.
  • One is called as a classical method, and another one is called as quantum chemistry method.
  • In this method, we are using Newton mechanics to model molecular system.
  • At the same time,.
  • The sum of all the energies of attractive and repulsive forces between atoms in the structure.
  • Namely molecular dynamics and molecular mechanics.
  • In case of quantum chemistry methods,.
  • This uses quantum mechanics to model the molecular system.
  • It is based on the arrangement of electrons in molecule and the interaction of these electrons with electron and the nuclei of another molecule.
  • And three important methods are there in the quantum chemistry based on this semi empirical methods, Abin show method and density functional theory.
  • First, particularly the molecular mechanics as well as molecular dynamics, followed by this, and we have to learn another three methods, namely semi-empirical methods eventually methods, density functional theory in detail.
  • What is molecular mechanics?
  • Molecular mechanics is a computational method used to study and predict the structure, stability, and properties of molecules using classical physics rather than quantum mechanics.
  • It is also based on the ball and spring model.
  • It's too fast like a very large molecules like steroids can be optimized in seconds and almost geometry optimization by using molecular mechanics in the classical methods.
  • The another technique is called molecular dynamics.
  • What is this molecular dynamics?
  • Molecular dynamics is a computer simulation technique in which time dependent behavior of a molecular system is studied by solving Newton's equation of motion of atoms and molecules.
  • Molecular dynamics is a molecular mechanism program and designed to mimic the movement of atoms within a molecule, again based on the law of motion of molecule, based on the molecular structure.
  • Molecular dynamics can be carried out on a molecule to generate different conformations which are energy minimizing minimization.
  • I hope you people have understood in the lower standards.
  • Take butane molecule.
  • Butane molecule is having different conformations.
  • What are these conformation?
  • The spati arrangement of methyl group in the plane.
  • In the semi-empirical form methods, particularly in the quantum mechanics, we do use semi-empirical method.
  • What is the semi-empirical method?
  • What is the definition?
  • Semi-empirical methods are quantum chemistry approaches that simplify the Schrödinger wave equation by making approximation and incorporating experimental data, particularly empirical parameters are used.
  • Usually semi-empirical methods values lie between av and show methods, completely quantum, very accurate, but expensive.

Core explanation · 05:00–09:59

In semi empirical calculations are based on completely Schrödinger equations.

Key details

  • It represents a middle road between the mostly qualitative results available from molecular mechanics and the high computationally demanding quantitative results from adventure methods, capable of calculating transition state and excited states.
  • What is abinshoe method?
  • First and foremost thing abinshoe is the Latin word.
  • It means from the beginning.
  • What is the definition of events show calculation or events method?
  • In computational chemistry, abinshow methods are first principles, quantum, mechanical calculation, and do not use empirical parameters.
  • Everything is derived from solving the Schrödinger equation using fundamental constants like electron charge, Planck's constant, etc.
  • In the F and Shoe method as already discussed based on the Schrödinger equation, it describes among other things how the electrons in a molecule behave.
  • The wave function is a mathematical function that can be used to calculate electron distribution.
  • Most accurate quantum chemical techniques, but computationally demanding, they serve as gold standard for validating other computational methods.
  • What is the definition for this?
  • Density functional theory is a quantum mechanical method used to investigate the electronic structure, especially ground state properties of atoms.
  • molecules and solids instead of solving for the mini electron wave function because it becomes very complex.
  • DFT works with electron density as the central variable.
  • Unlike the other two methods, DFT does not calculate conventional wave function, but rather derives the electron distribution directly.
  • Density functional calculations are usually faster than adio.
  • but slower than empirical methods.
  • In a simpler manner, DFD is a quantum method using electron density instead of wave functions.
  • Balances, accuracy, and computational efficiency.
  • Computational chemistry is very much essential nowadays.
  • We are going to use in the determination of electronic structure.
  • And predictions, energy minimization.
  • And we can find out the transition structure and reaction parts, molecular docking, protein coupling, protein interaction, protein ligand interactions.
  • All these are useful in developing particular molecule especially in the cancer drug anti-cancer drug molecule.
  • stagger, anti-gauche, gauche, and all these confirmation what is the stabilization energy that can be calculated by using computational chemistry.
  • Thermochemistry Usually in thermochemistry two reaction takes place one is exothermic and endothermic reactions and the heat of reactions can be easily calculated, energy of activation of the molecule can be calculated using computational chemistry.
  • Calculation of many other molecular physical and chemical properties can be explored by using computational chemistry methods.
  • Computational chemistry plays a vital role in progenitic world.

particularly in advancing our understanding of chemical system and accelerating scientific discovery.

Key details

  • It has one of the important advantages is that cost effectiveness, efficiency, safety, accessibility, versatility, and accuracy make it indispensable tool in modern research and development.
  • Computational chemistry is not a replacement from the lab.
  • Because we need to.
  • Perform the experiment to get a desired molecule.
  • But this computational chemistry will help us whether we are going to get desired molecule or not before conducting experiment in the lab.
  • That is what computational chemistry is not a replacement for experimental studies, but plays an important role in enabling chemists to design and develop the design chemicals and the product molecule.
